specification.problem: Exact synthesis of an n<=2 qubit unitary U with entries in Z[i,1/sqrt2] (form (a+b sqrt2+i(c+d sqrt2))/sqrt2^k) into a Clifford+T circuit of O(k) gates using at most one ancilla, via Giles-Selinger decomposition into 1- and 2-level matrices.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful instance: a 4x4 (n=2) unitary over Z[i,1/sqrt2] given explicitly with known sde k. Build the column-reduction into two-level matrices (classically), then compile each two-level matrix into Clifford+T gates (X, CX, H, S, T, Tdg, Toffoli decomposed) and verify via statevector/unitary comparison up to global phase. Out of scope: the paper's own optimized constants, its precise ancilla scheme for odd-determinant cases, the proof of O(k), and n>2.

symbols.meaning: least denominator exponent: smallest k with sqrt2^k U having entries in Z[omega]
primitive 8th root of unity e^{i\pi/4}, so T=diag(1,omega)
two-level unitary acting nontrivially only on basis states j,l
column of sqrt2^k U with entries in Z[omega]

symbols.domain: integer, m<=6 for dim 4 and m<=28 for dim 8 per sketch (an assumed bound)

equations.label: Ring form of entries
equations.description: Entries of U lie in Z[i,1/sqrt2] with denominator exponent k.
equations.justification: Stated directly in the abstract as the entry form.

equations.label: Two-level decomposition
equations.latex: U=E_m E_{m-1}\cdots E_1 \ \ (\text{each } E_t \text{ a 1- or 2-level matrix})
equations.description: U is a product of 1- and 2-level matrices, obtained by reducing columns one at a time to standard basis vectors, with the last diagonal entries being powers of omega.
equations.abstract_quote: decomposition into $1$- and $2$-level matrices which was first proposed by Giles and Selinger
equations.justification: The abstract names this decomposition. The ordering and the reduction to basis vectors follow Giles-Selinger from background knowledge.
assumptions: Factors are listed in the order they are applied to U^dagger, then inverted

equations.label: Gate-count bound
equations.description: Total Clifford+T gate count is linear in k.
equations.abstract_quote: This method achieves a bound of $O(k)$ gates using at most one ancilla

equations.label: Single-column sde reduction step
equations.description: A pair of entries (v_j,v_l) is lowered in sde by a phase correction by powers of omega and a Hadamard-like step, until the column is a basis vector times a power of omega.
equations.justification: Recalled Giles-Selinger-style arithmetic; the exact case analysis (residues mod sqrt2) is not given in the abstract and is not reproduced here.
assumptions: Pair choice and residue case analysis are left to the implementer

equations.label: Embedding a 2-level matrix as a controlled single-qubit gate
equations.latex: E_{(j,l)}=P^{\dagger}\,\mathrm{C}^{(n-1)}_{\text{pattern}}(W)\,P,\quad W\in U(2),\ W \text{ in the exact Clifford+T group}
equations.description: A Gray-code permutation P of X/CX gates makes the indices j,l adjacent, differing in one bit, so E acts as a single-qubit W on that target controlled by the remaining bits.
equations.justification: Standard construction for compiling two-level matrices.
assumptions: For n=2 there is one control; W is synthesized by a Matsumoto-Amano/KMM normal form with O(k) gates

registers.name: q
registers.role: data qubits, little-endian: basis index = q1*2+q0

registers.name: anc
registers.role: optional ancilla starting and ending in |0>, used to realize controlled operations or fix a phase/determinant obstruction

specification.initial_state: Verification only: unitary or statevector comparison of the circuit against U on basis states, with ancilla in |0>.

steps.description: Classically reduce each column of sqrt2^k U to a basis vector using two-level matrices over Z[omega] (sde-lowering H-type steps, omega-phase and X-type swap steps), recording the factors.
Invert and order the recorded two-level factors so their product is U, up to a final diagonal of omega powers, which is realized with T/S/Z gates and controlled phases.

Compile each factor: conjugate by X/CX to make the indices adjacent, synthesize the single-qubit W exactly in Clifford+T, and implement the control with a Toffoli or controlled-H/T identity, using the ancilla if needed (returned to |0>).
Concatenate all compiled factors; the total count is O(k) because the number of factors is bounded by a constant.

specification.classical_postprocessing: Exact Z[omega] arithmetic for the column reduction and normal-form synthesis; compare the simulated unitary (ancilla-projected) with U up to global phase.
assumptions: The input is an explicit exact matrix with ring entries and known k
Dimension is at most 4 for the main circuit, with one ancilla extending to 8
The global phase, a power of omega, is tracked classically or ignored
Gate set is H, S, T, X, CX, with Toffoli decomposed into Clifford+T
Each controlled two-level gate costs O(k) T gates
The factor-count bounds (6 and 28) come from the task sketch, not the abstract
missing_information: Exact case analysis of the sde-reduction rules
Exact ancilla construction and when it is needed
Explicit Clifford+T circuits for controlled W
Concrete constants in the O(k) bound
Handling of phases and determinants not realizable without an ancilla
